query:
SELECT id AS "audio_file_id!",
                  recording_session_id
             FROM audio_files
            WHERE user_id = $1
              AND guild_id = $2
              AND channel_id = $3
              AND start_ts <= $4
              AND end_ts IS NULL
              AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM live_audio_files live WHERE live.id = audio_files.id)
            ORDER BY start_ts DESC
            LIMIT 1
